Author:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>

    Bug 1837337 - increase timeout of comm/mail/test/browser/tabmail/browser_dragndrop.js for some special builds. r=aleca
    
    
    From logs, seems it's at least primarily slow.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D253161

diff --git a/mail/test/browser/tabmail/browser_dragndrop.js b/mail/test/browser/tabmail/browser_dragndrop.js
index cc3f482de92..98bb5c8120f 100644
--- a/mail/test/browser/tabmail/browser_dragndrop.js
+++ b/mail/test/browser/tabmail/browser_dragndrop.js
@@ -4,8 +4,14 @@
 
 "use strict";
 
-// Double timeout for code coverage runs.
-if (AppConstants.MOZ_CODE_COVERAGE) {
+if (
+  AppConstants.MOZ_CODE_COVERAGE ||
+  AppConstants.ASAN ||
+  AppConstants.DEBUG ||
+  AppConstants.TSAN
+) {
+  requestLongerTimeout(3);
+} else if (AppConstants.platform == "macosx") {
   requestLongerTimeout(2);
 }
title: Bug 1837337 - increase timeout of comm/mail/test/browser/tabmail/browser_dragndrop.js for some special builds. r=aleca
